verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own materials say its bot covers Zoom, Google Meet and Teams ("Zoom, GMeet, Teams, +more"), and Google Meet auto-recording is called out separately. You choose what gets recorded by inviting fred@fireflies.ai to a meeting or letting it auto-join calendar meetings. missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence that capture is reliable, Zoom- and Teams-specific recording detail beyond a pricing-page list, and documented per-meeting rules for which meetings get recorded.
